div.head: VI Atr 2
div.ab: K. ⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt abbodas ⁊ abbodissan heora agen lif rihtlice fadian ⁊ eac heora heorda wislice healdan,
⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt abbodas ⁊ abbodissan heora agen lif rihtlice fadian ⁊ eac heora heorda wislice healdan
And witena gerædnes is, þæt abbodas and abbodissan heora agen lif rihtlice fadian and eac heora heorda wislice healdan.
Und Verordnung der Witan ist, dass Äbte und Äbtissinnen ihr eigenes Leben gesetzmässig ordnen und auch ihre Heerden weise halten,
And it is the ordinance of the witan that abbots and abbesses order their own lives lawfully and also keep their flocks wisely,
And the decree of the councillors is, that abbots and abbesses shall order their own lives aright, and also keep their flocks with wisdom,
And the decree of the councilors is that abbots and abbesses are to order their own lives rightly and also oversee their flocks wisely.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
